# Glow-TTS (Coqui LJ Speech)

Coqui TTS / Eren Gölge @erogol · released 2021-03

Exact registry entry tts\_models/en/ljspeech/glow-tts. Default vocoder vocoder\_models/en/ljspeech/multiband-melgan. Model archive responded HTTP 200 to a HEAD request on 2026-09-29. CPU command documented by maintained Coqui TTS; phoneme models may require the espeak-ng system package. Memory is an estimated 4GB runtime budget, not measured usage. No original-paper MOS transferred to this separately trained checkpoint.

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp32 · CPU, needs ~4 GB, from [github.com/idiap](https://github.com/idiap/coqui-ai-TTS/blob/ca2cf5155bca892ea820ad384400efbfac41b178/TTS/.models.json))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --python 3.11 --with 'coqui-tts[languages]' --with torch --with torchaudio --with torchcodec tts --model_name tts_models/en/ljspeech/glow-tts --text "Hello world." --out_path speech.wav --device cpu
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [github.com/idiap](https://github.com/idiap/coqui-ai-TTS/blob/ca2cf5155bca892ea820ad384400efbfac41b178/TTS/.models.json)
